content: Silawun agulivan ma̱wan: Tanuwagan lun avakaein datoveks Yeisuw nisin Yowbad nakabkaleiwag wanaka̱tay walba̱lab; iwwotet Yowbad nabunatum mounid waseg. Gamag nag iwlules; Yowbad niwlul.
Tanuwgwes lun babaw siwotet isiwa̱youbs o iluns waseg Yowbad. Towen-vak, kadiloka kweitan youd bisek Yowbad.
Kukin bises ven watinow, gamag nag bisekes nawotet mamagina tanuwagan lun; peinan tanuwgwes lun nisesus, igawa ivvaluts Moses nakaleiwag waseg.
Tasiyas sibunatum mamagina Yowbad nabunatum walba̱lab, peinan itakayasis. Kweiboug Moses sivinan biwlul kid Yowbad nabunatum, Yowbad mo idibek, ilana,

content.text: “Kadiloka kuvakaes youd babaw ma̱wan magin ankakin towen nakatimlakeim wa̱koy.”

content: Tage Kelis nakaleiwag bo ilisow Moses nakaleiwag. O nawotet-vak, ilisow tasiyas siwotet. Peinan sinap towen Yowbad nilivnek, singaya imug.
Kukin nag kweitan abkalouw bises waseg kaleiwag kweiboug, nag beivag sivinan kwayuwein.
Tage bo ikakin-wan asisinap bo ika̱bwag, ilana:

content.text: Igaw tut wanakougwaw mo basek kweivaw kaleiwag wasigeis min-Yisleil sisiy min-Yud.
Nag ma̱wan kaleiwag towen nasekes tibsiyas, misumkwey natokes, namgwayes, mo ilisawes Yidipt.
“Tut towen beikous mo basekes min-Yisleil sikaleiwag kweivaw.
Gunakaleiwag basein waninous o balel wakates mo bamlavag siYowbad, o tasiyas gungamag.
Nag bikamtilakes sisiyas o budisiyas bilansa, ‘Kadiloka kukwakins Yowbad,’ nag.
Tasiyas toul sisiyas guyawaw bikakinsa yey.
Asisinap kalbaleb waseg bo binok nuwag, banumlev, mo beikous.”

content: Liva̱nen kaleiwag kweivaw bo isek, mapuna ipiyev kweiboug kaleiwag. Kaleiwag kweiboug inawotet bo ikous. Kakita bikanig.
